# Tuning reference

Every value on the `VtTuning` asset, with the default the package ships, the allowed range and what it changes. For how to use it, see [Tuning](../modules/tuning.md).

## VtTuning

Asset. Create it with **Create → Vantage → Tuning**.

Project-wide gameplay numbers in one asset: combat clamps, ability timing, projectiles, threat, multiplayer limits, party and loot, social limits and movement feel. Read the live values through `Instance`; `VtCombatConstants`, `VtThreatConstants` and `VtMovementConstants` are read-only views of the same asset.

### Inspector fields

#### Combat clamps

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Max Resistance (`maxResistance`) | `float` | 0.75 | 0 to 1 | Maximum per-element resistance fraction (hard cap). 0.75 = 75% cap so stacked resistances can't reach 'immune'. |
| Max Evade Chance (`maxEvadeChance`) | `float` | 0.8 | 0 to 1 | Maximum evade chance fraction. 0.80 = at least 20% of hits always land. |
| Max Crit Chance (`maxCritChance`) | `float` | 1 | 0 to 1 | Maximum crit chance fraction. 1.0 = every swing may crit; stacking past 100% is wasted. |
| Default Crit Multiplier (`defaultCritMultiplier`) | `float` | 2 | ≥ 1 | Base multiplier on a successful crit before any stat.crit_multiplier bonus. 2.0 = crit doubles damage; a '+50% crit damage' item adds 0.5 on top. |
| Armor K (`armorK`) | `float` | 100 | ≥ 0.01 | K in the armor formula damage × K / (K + armor). Lower = each armor point matters more; higher = smoother diminishing returns. |
| Min Attack Interval (`minAttackInterval`) | `float` | 0.1 | ≥ 0.01 | Floor on attack interval (seconds) after attack-speed modifiers. Prevents unbounded DPS from stacked haste. |
| Max Cooldown Reduction (`maxCooldownReduction`) | `float` | 0.8 | 0 to 1 | Hard cap on cooldown-reduction fraction. 0.80 = a 10s spell bottoms out at 2s. |
| Thorns Filter (`thornsFilter`) | [VtThornsFilter](#vtthornsfilter) | `PhysicalOnly` |  | Which incoming damage triggers stat.thorns reflection. PhysicalOnly = classic spiked armor (casters punch through); All = every direct hit is reflected. |
| Out Of Combat Threshold (`outOfCombatThreshold`) | `float` | 5 | ≥ 0 | Seconds without an incoming or outgoing hit before a unit counts as out of combat. Drives CombatOnly / OutOfCombatOnly regen. 5s is a common choice for action RPGs. |

#### Abilities

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Global Cooldown (`globalCooldown`) | `float` | 1.5 | ≥ 0 | Global cooldown in seconds after a GCD-triggering cast. Abilities opt in via triggersGcd and opt out of respecting it via ignoresGcd. 1.5s is typical for MMO-style combat. |
| Min Cast Time (`minCastTime`) | `float` | 0 | ≥ 0 | Cast times below this floor (seconds) are treated as instant. 0 = no floor. |
| Min Ability Cooldown (`minAbilityCooldown`) | `float` | 0 | ≥ 0 | Floor on ability cooldown (seconds). 0 = zero-cooldown abilities allowed (the GCD still governs them). |
| Max Ability Queue Depth (`maxAbilityQueueDepth`) | `int` | 1 | ≥ 0 | How many ability presses a unit buffers while mid-cast. 0 = presses during a cast are dropped; 1 = one buffered press fires when the cast resolves. |
| Cast Pushback Seconds (`castPushbackSeconds`) | `float` | 0.5 | ≥ 0 | Seconds a hit adds to the cast bar of an ability whose Damage Reaction is Pushback. The bar never grows past its full cast time. |
| Channel Pushback Fraction (`channelPushbackFraction`) | `float` | 0.25 | 0 to 1 | Share of the full channel duration a hit removes from a channel whose Damage Reaction is Pushback. 0.25 = each hit takes away a quarter of the channel. |
| Max Pushbacks (`maxPushbacks`) | `int` | 2 | ≥ 0 | How many hits can push back one cast, and separately one channel. Later hits do nothing. 0 = hits never push back. |

#### Projectiles

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Projectile Arrival Radius (`projectileArrivalRadius`) | `float` | 0.3 | ≥ 0.01 | Distance (world units) from the target at which a projectile counts as arrived and resolves damage. |
| Projectile Max Lifetime (`projectileMaxLifetime`) | `float` | 10 | ≥ 0.1 | Safety limit on projectile lifetime (seconds). A projectile that hasn't arrived by then self-destructs. |
| Projectile Spawn Height (`projectileSpawnHeight`) | `float` | 1 |  | Spawn height above the caster's transform.position (world units). 1.0 puts the projectile at roughly shoulder / bow height. |

#### Threat

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Heal Threat Ratio (`healThreatRatio`) | `float` | 0.5 | ≥ 0 | Fraction of a heal that becomes threat on the healer, on every hostile already engaging the healed unit. 0.5 = healing 100 adds 50 threat. |
| Taunt Multiplier (`tauntMultiplier`) | `float` | 1.1 | ≥ 1 | A taunt sets the caster's threat to the current top × this. 1.1 = 10% above whoever was leading, so one taunt sticks for a beat under continued damage. |
| Call For Help Ratio (`callForHelpRatio`) | `float` | 0.25 | ≥ 0 | Fraction of damage propagated to faction-mates within aggroRange ('call for help'). 0 disables propagation. Per-unit override on VtThreatAutoSubscriber. |

#### Multiplayer

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Interact Range Tolerance (`interactRangeTolerance`) | `float` | 1.5 | ≥ 0 | Extra world units past a pickable's own radius that the authority still accepts an interact command from a client at. Covers replication lag between the client's and the authority's idea of where the player stands. |
| Max Commands Per Second (`maxCommandsPerSecond`) | `float` | 15 | ≥ 0 | Commands the authority accepts from one unit per second, on average. 0 = no limit. A burst up to Command Burst is allowed before the average applies. |
| Command Burst (`commandBurst`) | `int` | 10 | ≥ 1 | How many commands a unit may send at once before the per-second limit applies. |
| Interest Margin (`interestMargin`) | `float` | 2 | ≥ 0 | Extra world units past a viewer's vision radius within which other units are still sent to that client. Hides the edge of vision from pop-in. |
| Interest Update Interval (`interestUpdateInterval`) | `float` | 0.25 | ≥ 0.05 | Seconds between visibility passes on the server when interest management is on. |

#### Movement feel

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Acceleration (`acceleration`) | `float` | 15 | ≥ 0 | Ramp from 0 to top speed, in units/s². Higher = snappier starts. |
| Rotation Speed (`rotationSpeed`) | `float` | 720 | ≥ 0 | Turn rate toward the movement direction, in degrees per second. |
| Waypoint Reach Distance (`waypointReachDistance`) | `float` | 0.2 | ≥ 0.01 | Distance at which a waypoint counts as reached and path following advances. |
| Unreachable Tolerance (`unreachableTolerance`) | `float` | 1 | ≥ 0 | If a path's endpoint is farther than this (planar) from the requested destination, the destination is unreachable and movement does not start. Per-request override: MoveTo(..., acceptPartialPath: true). |
| Stuck Abort Time (`stuckAbortTime`) | `float` | 0.5 | ≥ 0 | Seconds of sub-threshold movement before stuck recovery skips the current waypoint. |
| Stuck Movement Threshold (`stuckMovementThreshold`) | `float` | 0.25 | 0 to 1 | Fraction of full speed below which the agent counts as not moving for stuck detection. |
| Gravity (`gravity`) | `float` | 20 | ≥ 0 | Downward acceleration while the CharacterController is airborne (units/s²). |

#### Server-authoritative movement

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Movement Reconcile Threshold (`movementReconcileThreshold`) | `float` | 1 | ≥ 0 | A predicting client snaps to the authority's position when the two differ by more than this many world units on the ground plane. Smaller corrects sooner and more visibly. |
| Movement Reconcile Speed (`movementReconcileSpeed`) | `float` | 8 | ≥ 0 | How fast a predicting client closes a correction, as a fraction per second. 8 removes most of it in a quarter second; 0 snaps at once. |
| Replica Follow Speed (`replicaFollowSpeed`) | `float` | 10 | ≥ 0 | How fast a replica follows the authority's position, as a fraction per second. 10 closes most of the gap in a tenth of a second; 0 snaps instantly. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `static VtTuning Instance { get; }` | The live tuning: the one handed to `OverrideInstance`, else your `Assets/Resources/VtTuning.asset`, else the package's defaults. If neither asset exists, an in-memory instance with the compiled defaults is used and a warning logs once. |
| `static void ResetCache()` | Forgets the cached tuning so the next `Instance` read loads the asset again. Use it after swapping the asset in the editor, or in test teardown after `OverrideInstance`. |
| `static void OverrideInstance(VtTuning instance)` | Use `instance` as the live tuning, such as a copy a boot scene references or a test's `CreateInstance<VtTuning>()` with a few fields changed. Call it before gameplay starts. Pass null to behave like `ResetCache`. |

## Enums

### VtThornsFilter

Selects which incoming damage is eligible for `stat.thorns` reflection. Game-wide toggle via `VtCombatConstants.ThornsFilter`; default `PhysicalOnly`.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `All` | Every direct hit reflects, except True damage and damage over time. |
| `PhysicalOnly` | Only incoming `VtDamageType.Physical` hits reflect, so spell casters are not punished by thorns. |
